messages:
jess: Starting rollout v2.14.0 -> prod now. 30m change window. Can everyone please keep an eye on the SLO dashboards (p95, error rate, 5xx) and call any holds immediately.

deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.14.0 -> prod (canary traffic 10%). smoke tests: passed. health checks: green.

slo-monitor: canary metrics (last 5m): p95=180ms (SLO=200ms), error_rate=0.12% (SLO=0.5%), 5xx_count=3.

sabrina: I see those 5xx entries from embed-worker-3. Sample log:```
2026-06-04T14:22:03Z ERROR embed-worker-3 request_id=abc123 status=500 err="kv-cache miss -> nil pointer"
stack: runtime.go:245 handleRequest
```

matt: Are these user-facing 500s or retries from internal jobs? any 429s?

jess: user-facing, small sample so far. no 429s. I'm going to pause promotion at 30% until we triage — @matt @rafael can you take a look at serving runtime?

rafael: pulling traces now. spikes line up with long-tail KV-cache GC on GPU host gpu-cluster-7. one host shows repeated GC stalls ~300ms. restarting that worker should clear it. Proposal: route new requests to fallback model v2.13 for 2–5m while we restart.

deploy-bot: hold requested by jess. Available actions: `/deploy pause`, `/deploy rollback v2.14.0 --canary`, `/deploy route --version v2.13 --scope canary`

sabrina: will tail logs during restart and confirm. If restart clears errors, we can retry with a config tweak (reduce kv-cache GC interval).

matt: I'll run the routing pin to v2.13 for the canary and restart the node. Command:```/deploy route --version v2.13 --scope canary --duration 5m```

deploy-bot: action executed: routed canary traffic to v2.13 (100% canary) for 5m.

slo-monitor: post-action metrics (next 5m): p95=160ms, 5xx_count=0, error_rate=0.03%. traces cleared for gpu-cluster-7.

jess: thanks team. We'll keep the change window open for 10m and attempt a new rollout after Rafael's config tweak to kv-cache. I'll capture this in the release notes and flag the rollback decision rationale. :thumbsup:

rafael: quick note — adding the GC interval tweak to the rollout config and will post diff in #eng-releases when ready.

sabrina: confirmed no new 500s in logs. closing the immediate incident.

jess: marking hold lifted in 10m if all metrics stay green. great coordination.
